title: M9-C42.21 — Milestone M21.9 Verification Architecture Forward Scan
scope: Assess whether current framework can represent the full verification graph, planner requirements, evidence architecture, historical intelligence, profile certification, and CI/workflow integration — as required for the final self-verifying ClariFin_OS system.

file_to_symbol.current: mutmut generates mutant names with file:function__mutmut_N; capability mapping uses directory patterns; no unified file→symbol index for all production code.
file_to_symbol.gap: No single authoritative mapping from repository file to symbol/function for ALL production code (only mutation-eligible subset in ENGINE_SELECTION). Deferred components and Tier 3 excluded components have no mapping.
file_to_symbol.required_for: automatic verification scope determination from changed files

symbol_to_capability.current: ENGINE_SELECTION maps engine → capability implicitly (via test_selection paths). M9-C42.20 scope manifest has component→capability but not symbol-level.
symbol_to_capability.gap: Symbol-to-capability mapping missing for deferred components, Tier 3 components, and new engines. Existing mapping is engine-granular, not symbol-granular.
symbol_to_capability.required_for: fine-grained verification scope (only affected capabilities from changed symbols)

capability_to_profile.current: Verification profiles (quick, unit, property, mutation, contract, golden, e2e, full) exist in runtime/foundation/verification/profiles.py with scope/prerequisites. But mutation profile is not integrated into profile execution (no gate enforcement in CI).
capability_to_profile.gap: Profile execution is CLI-driven (verify.py) but not wired into CI gate semantics. Mutation profile lacks artifact expectations and failure semantics in profile definition.
capability_to_profile.required_for: automatic profile selection based on changed capabilities

profile_to_test.current: pytest markers (unit, property, contract, capability, invariant, golden, mutation) exist. Test selection for mutation is via ENGINE_SELECTION.test_selection. Other profiles use marker-based selection.
profile_to_test.gap: No unified test-to-profile mapping that is queryable programmatically (e.g., 'which tests belong to mutation profile for capability X?'). ENGINE_SELECTION is the only complete mapping.

test_to_evidence.current: Mutation: complete evidence chain (mutant → status → diff → summary → classification). Coverage: line/branch data only. Contract: schemathesis runs but evidence not integrated. Golden: datasets exist but evidence format varies. E2E: Playwright runs but evidence format separate.
test_to_evidence.gap: Unified evidence schema across ALL verification layers. Current evidence per layer is siloed (different JSON schemas, locations, formats).
test_to_evidence.required_for: cross-layer evidence aggregation and gate decisions

evidence_to_gate.current: Mutation: 3-gate model (A/B/C) with explicit PASS/FAIL/NOT_EVALUABLE. Coverage: pytest-cov threshold (40% overall, 70% engines). Other layers: manual interpretation.
evidence_to_gate.gap: No unified gate model across layers. Each layer has different failure semantics and no composite gate.
evidence_to_gate.required_for: single composite gate decision from multi-layer evidence

changed_files_detection.current: runtime/foundation/verification/planner/ can compute changed files from git diff.

affected_capabilities.current: Can map changed files → engines via ENGINE_SELECTION source_paths. Cannot map changed files → capabilities for non-mutation-eligible code.
affected_capabilities.gap: Capability mapping incomplete for deferred/Tier 3 code.

dependency_expansion.current: No dependency graph expansion from changed symbols to transitive capabilities.
dependency_expansion.gap: Required for 'unknown → expand verification' fail-safe behavior.

verification_profiles.current: Profiles defined with scope/prerequisites/commands. Not executable as a unified planner output.
verification_profiles.gap: Planner should output: required profiles + required tests per profile + evidence expectations.

unknown_mapping.current: If file→symbol or symbol→capability mapping is missing, planner behavior undefined.
unknown_mapping.required: unknown → expand verification (run broader profile, not skip). Currently not implemented.

missing_capability.current: If capability not registered, planner behavior undefined.
missing_capability.required: missing capability → run full profile (max verification). Not implemented.

missing_profile.current: If profile not defined for capability, behavior undefined.
missing_profile.required: missing profile → fall back to 'full' profile. Not implemented.

ambiguous_dependency.current: No ambiguity detection in dependency graph.

missing_test.current: Planner does not verify test existence for selected profile.
missing_test.required: missing test → report as evidence gap (Class D), not skip.

missing_evidence.current: No evidence completeness check in planner.
missing_evidence.required: missing evidence → NOT EVALUABLE, not PASS.

stale_cache.current: Mutation runner validates cache provenance (repository_sha, config_hash, mutmut_version). Other layers no cache validation.
stale_cache.gap: Unified cache/provenance validation across all layers.

incomplete_execution.current: Mutation enforces not_checked=0. Other layers have no equivalent.
incomplete_execution.gap: Unified execution completeness gate across layers.

gaps: No unified run_id across layers (mutation has run_id; coverage/contract/e2e/golden do not)
No unified commit_sha/tree_sha/timestamp/environment across layers
No unified scope manifest (what was verified in this run)
No unified failures.json (all failures across layers)
No unified certification.json (composite gate decision)
Artifact locations scattered: backend/tests/generated/, runtime/generated/, frontend test results/
Schema inconsistency: each layer has different JSON structure
No historical linkage (run_id → previous run_id)
minimum_convergence_path: 1. Define unified VerificationRun schema (run_id, commit_sha, tree_sha, timestamp, env, scope, results, evidence, decision)
2. Wrap each layer's execution to emit VerificationRun-compatible artifact
3. Add aggregator that merges layer artifacts into single VerificationRun
4. Add historical index (run_id → previous run_id, delta computation)
5. Define composite gate evaluator on aggregated evidence

historical_verification_gaps.current: Mutation evidence stored per-milestone (m9-c42.19-mutation-completion.json, etc.). Coverage stored in m9-c42.19-coverage-analysis.json. No cross-milestone delta computation.
historical_verification_gaps.required_capability: Identify across commits: coverage↓, mutation↓, survivors↑, capability_verification↓, test_count↓, new_unmapped_production_logic, new_evidence_gaps.
gaps: No unified historical store (per-milestone files only)
No delta computation engine
No trend detection (e.g., mutation score declining over N runs)
No regression alerting on capability verification degradation
No 'new unmapped production logic' detection (requires file→symbol→capability mapping)

gaps_per_profile.quick: scope/prerequisites defined; artifact expectations missing; gate semantics missing
gaps_per_profile.unit: scope=unit tests; mutation not included; gate=coverage threshold only
gaps_per_profile.contract: scope=contract tests; schemathesis runs; evidence schema not unified; gate not defined
gaps_per_profile.mutation: CLI certified; CI gate NOT certified; artifact expectations defined; failure semantics defined (3-gate)
gaps_per_profile.golden: scope=golden datasets; evidence format custom; gate not defined
gaps_per_profile.e2e: scope=Playwright; CI exists (frontend-verify.yml); gate=test pass; evidence not unified

profile_certification_gaps.next: Certify each profile: define scope, prerequisites, commands, expected artifacts, failure semantics, timeout, parallelism, evidence completeness, gate behavior. Start with mutation CI gate, then contract, then full.

gaps: Mutation campaign runs in CI but NOT gated (verification-runtime.yml runs mutation but does not fail CI on score < 80%)
No reusable action for mutation campaign (uses inline steps; violates M9-C42.5 reusable_setup decision)
Evidence artifacts not uploaded as named artifacts with retention policy
No composite gate: workflow passes if individual steps pass; no cross-layer gate
Deferred components (transaction_intelligence, financial_intelligence) not tracked in CI
No historical comparison step in CI (compare current run vs baseline)
Mutation smoke test not in PR gate (only full campaign in scheduled)
required_for_certification: Reusable action for mutation campaign (setup, execute, capture, upload)
Composite gate action (consumes VerificationRun, evaluates all layer gates, fails if any NOT_EVALUABLE/FAIL)
Baseline comparison step (compare current VerificationRun vs stored baseline)
Evidence artifact retention (90 days minimum for certification evidence)
Deferred component tracking in CI (fail build if unmapped production logic added without capability registration)

summary.verification_graph: PARTIAL — file→symbol→capability mapping complete only for 12 mutation-eligible engines; deferred/Tier 3 unmapped
summary.planner: PARTIAL — changed files detection works; fail-safe behaviors (unknown→expand) NOT IMPLEMENTED
summary.evidence_architecture: SILOS — mutation evidence complete; other layers use different schemas/locations; no unified run structure
summary.historical: PER-MILESTONE ONLY — no delta engine, no trend detection, no regression alerts
summary.profiles: DEFINED NOT CERTIFIED — mutation CLI certified; CI gate + artifact expectations missing; full profile not implemented
summary.workflows: MUTATION NOT GATED — CI runs mutation but does not enforce score; no reusable action; no composite gate
summary.overall_readiness: MUTATION EVIDENCE READY FOR CONSUMPTION; verification architecture requires cross-layer unification before final self-verifying system certification.
